title: Write a single long prompt that includes a timecoded beat-by-beat storyboard…
content:
Write a single long prompt that includes a timecoded beat-by-beat storyboard (e.g., 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s) with explicit camera action, subject motion, and constraints per beat to generate a full 15s ad in one Seedance 2 run.

Lock the “look” by specifying lens and exposure details (100mm macro, shallow DOF, f/2.8), lighting setup (high-key studio + warm backlit rim), and background (neutral studio backdrop) to keep consistent lens character and color temperature across the whole video.

Force identity consistency across beats by explicitly instructing “Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats” and “Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.”

Prevent unwanted edits by adding constraints like “No cuts within a beat” and “No on-screen text until the final beat.”

Control motion stability and symmetry by explicitly directing camera behavior (rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan) and composition rules (radial symmetrical explosion) inside the prompt.

If you need diegetic sound, include an “Audio, diegetic only” section with per-beat sound cues (whoosh, crackle, splatter/sizzle, paper crinkle, chime) so the model targets specific audio moments.

Specify delivery settings in the prompt (4K, 24fps) to target the desired resolution and frame rate.

es.content:
Escribe un único prompt largo que incluya un storyboard beat by beat con timecodes (por ejemplo, 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s), con acción de cámara explícita, movimiento del sujeto y restricciones por beat para generar un anuncio completo de 15 s en una sola ejecución de Seedance 2.

Bloquea el “look” especificando los detalles de lente y exposición (100mm macro, shallow DOF, f/2.8), la configuración de iluminación (high-key studio + warm backlit rim) y el fondo (neutral studio backdrop) para mantener una caracterización de lente y una temperatura de color consistentes en todo el video.

Fuerza la consistencia de identidad entre beats indicando explícitamente “Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats” y “Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.”

Evita ediciones no deseadas añadiendo restricciones como “No cuts within a beat” y “No on-screen text until the final beat.”

Controla la estabilidad y la simetría del movimiento dirigiendo explícitamente el comportamiento de la cámara (rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan) y las reglas de composición (radial symmetrical explosion) dentro del prompt.

Si necesitas sonido diegético, incluye una sección “Audio, diegetic only” con indicaciones de sonido por beat (whoosh, crackle, splatter/sizzle, paper crinkle, chime) para que el modelo apunte a momentos de audio específicos.

Especifica los ajustes de entrega en el prompt (4K, 24fps) para apuntar a la resolución y la tasa de fotogramas deseadas.

fr.content:
Rédigez un seul prompt long qui inclut un storyboard détaillé, battement par battement, avec timecodes (par ex. 0–3 s, 3–6 s, 6–9 s, 9–12 s, 12–15 s), en précisant explicitement l’action de caméra, le mouvement du sujet et les contraintes pour chaque battement afin de générer une publicité complète de 15 s en une seule exécution Seedance 2.

Verrouillez le « look » en spécifiant les détails de l’objectif et de l’exposition (100 mm macro, faible profondeur de champ, f/2.8), le setup d’éclairage (high-key studio + warm backlit rim) et l’arrière-plan (neutral studio backdrop) afin de conserver une cohérence du caractère de l’objectif et de la température de couleur sur toute la vidéo.

فرضez la cohérence d’identité d’un battement à l’autre en indiquant explicitement « Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats » et « Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout. »

Empêchez les modifications indésirables en ajoutant des contraintes comme « No cuts within a beat » et « No on-screen text until the final beat. »

Contrôlez la stabilité du mouvement et la symétrie en dirigeant explicitement le comportement de la caméra (rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan) et les règles de composition (radial symmetrical explosion) dans le prompt.

Si vous avez besoin de son diégétique, incluez une section « Audio, diegetic only » avec des indications sonores par battement (whoosh, crackle, splatter/sizzle, paper crinkle, chime) afin que le modèle cible des moments audio précis.

Spécifiez les paramètres de livraison dans le prompt (4K, 24fps) pour viser la résolution et la cadence d’images souhaitées.

ja.content:
単一の長い prompt を書き、タイムコード付きのビートごとの storyboard（例: 0–3s、3–6s、6–9s、9–12s、12–15s）を含めて、各ビートごとに明示的な camera action、subject motion、制約を入れ、Seedance 2 の1回の実行で15秒の完全な ad を生成するようにする。

レンズと露出の詳細（100mm macro、shallow DOF、f/2.8）、ライティング設定（high-key studio + warm backlit rim）、背景（neutral studio backdrop）を指定して「look」を固定し、動画全体で一貫したレンズ特性と color temperature を維持する。

“Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats” および “Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.” と明示的に指示して、ビート間の identity consistency を強制する。

“No cuts within a beat” や “No on-screen text until the final beat.” のような制約を追加して、不要な編集を防ぐ。

“rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan” のように camera の挙動を明確に指示し、さらに “radial symmetrical explosion” のような composition ルールを prompt 内で指定して、motion stability と symmetry を制御する。

diegetic sound が必要な場合は、各ビートごとの sound cue（whoosh、crackle、splatter/sizzle、paper crinkle、chime）を含む “Audio, diegetic only” セクションを入れて、モデルが特定の audio moment を狙えるようにする。

希望する解像度と frame rate を狙うために、prompt 内で delivery settings（4K、24fps）を指定する。

ko.content:
하나의 긴 prompt를 작성하되, 15초짜리 광고 전체를 한 번의 Seedance 2 실행으로 생성할 수 있도록 시간 코드가 포함된 beat-by-beat storyboard를 넣으세요(예: 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s). 각 beat마다 명시적인 camera action, subject motion, 그리고 제약 조건을 포함해야 합니다.

렌즈와 노출 세부사항(100mm macro, shallow DOF, f/2.8), 조명 설정(high-key studio + warm backlit rim), 배경(neutral studio backdrop)을 지정해 “look”을 고정하고, 영상 전체에서 일관된 lens character와 color temperature를 유지하세요.

“Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats”와 “Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.”라고 명시적으로 지시해 beat 간 identity consistency를 강제하세요.

“No cuts within a beat”와 “No on-screen text until the final beat.” 같은 제약을 추가해 원치 않는 편집을 방지하세요.

카메라 동작(rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan)과 구도 규칙(radial symmetrical explosion)을 prompt 안에서 직접 명시해 motion stability와 symmetry를 제어하세요.

diegetic sound가 필요하다면, 각 beat별 sound cue(whoosh, crackle, splatter/sizzle, paper crinkle, chime)를 포함한 “Audio, diegetic only” 섹션을 넣어 모델이 특정 오디오 순간을 타겟하도록 하세요.

원하는 해상도와 프레임 레이트를 맞추기 위해 prompt에 delivery settings(4K, 24fps)를 명시하세요.

pt.content:
Escreva um único prompt longo que inclua um storyboard beat-by-beat com timecode (por exemplo, 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–9s, 9–12s, 12–15s), com ação de câmera explícita, movimento do sujeito e restrições por beat para gerar um anúncio completo de 15s em uma única execução do Seedance 2.

Trave o “look” especificando detalhes de lente e exposição (100mm macro, shallow DOF, f/2.8), configuração de iluminação (high-key studio + warm backlit rim) e fundo (neutral studio backdrop) para manter consistentes o caráter da lente e a temperatura de cor ao longo de todo o vídeo.

Force a consistência de identidade entre os beats instruindo explicitamente “Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats” e “Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.”

Evite edições indesejadas adicionando restrições como “No cuts within a beat” e “No on-screen text until the final beat.”

Controle a estabilidade e a simetria do movimento direcionando explicitamente o comportamento da câmera (rock steady, dead center, slow push-in, snap-pan) e as regras de composição (radial symmetrical explosion) dentro do prompt.

Se precisar de som diegético, inclua uma seção “Audio, diegetic only” com cues de áudio por beat (whoosh, crackle, splatter/sizzle, paper crinkle, chime) para que o modelo mire momentos sonoros específicos.

Especifique as configurações de entrega no prompt (4K, 24fps) para atingir a resolução e a taxa de quadros desejadas.

zh.content:
写一个单一的长 prompt，包含带时间码的逐拍 storyboard（例如 0–3s、3–6s、6–9s、9–12s、12–15s），并为每一拍明确写出 camera action、subject motion 和约束条件，以便在一次 Seedance 2 运行中生成完整的 15 秒广告。

通过指定镜头和曝光细节来锁定“look”（100mm macro、shallow DOF、f/2.8），以及 lighting setup（high-key studio + warm backlit rim）和背景（neutral studio backdrop），以保持整个视频中镜头特性和色温的一致性。

通过明确指令“Maintain identical [subject] identity, [design] and branding across all five beats”以及“Consistent studio lighting, color temperature, and lens character throughout.”来强制各拍之间的身份一致性。

通过添加诸如“No cuts within a beat”和“No on-screen text until the final beat.”之类的约束，防止不必要的编辑。

通过在 prompt 中明确指示 camera 行为（rock steady、dead center、slow push-in、snap-pan）和构图规则（radial symmetrical explosion），来控制运动稳定性和对称性。

如果需要 diegetic sound，请加入一个“Audio, diegetic only”部分，并为每一拍提供声音提示（whoosh、crackle、splatter/sizzle、paper crinkle、chime），以便模型锁定特定的音频时刻。

在 prompt 中指定交付设置（4K、24fps），以匹配所需的分辨率和帧率。
